description: Frequency-split time-blur: generates a version of the source with only the UPPER spectral channels (above blurabov Hz) time-blurred over blurfact seconds, while everything below stays crisp - blur blur with a crossover frequency. Optional locut (-l) additionally removes bass below a cutoff. All three controls verified live (blurfact 0.5 vs 1.5 and -l300 each change the render). blurfact's range is input-dependent: 2 analysis frames to the analysed duration ('0'/'100' refused verbatim: 'Parameter[1] Value (...) out of range (0.002902 to 2.025941)'); blurabov and locut run 0 to nyquist. No breakpoint-capable parameters (blurfact/blurabov refuse 'brkpnt_files not permitted', parameters 1/2). Static duration (2.0230 / 1.5209); deterministic. A CDP Release 8 program (no HTML manual page beyond the r8 list). Operates on PVOC analysis files (.ana).
musical_use: Selective haze: keep the articulate low-mid body of a sound intact while its brilliance smears into a wash - like fog rolling over just the top of the spectrum (the name evokes a distant train: fundamentals chugging, highs streaming). Sweet spots: percussive/speech material with blurabov at 1-3 kHz turns consonants and attack-sizzle into halo while rhythm stays legible; long blurfact (toward the file length) freezes the upper spectrum into a static sheen. Against plain blur blur (uniform smear) this preserves intelligibility; against hilite bltr it neither thins nor traces - it purely splits the time-resolution of the two registers. locut doubles as a rumble-strip when the un-blurred low band is unwanted.

blurfact.description: Time over which the upper spectrum is blurred. CDP-enforced from 2 analysis frames to the input's analysed duration ('0' and '100' refused verbatim quoting '(0.002902 to 2.025941)' on a 2.023 s analysis - input-dependent both ends). Breakpoint refused (parameter 1).

blurabov.description: Frequency above which the spectrum is blurred. CDP-enforced 0 to nyquist ('-5'/'30000' refused verbatim, Parameter[2]). Breakpoint refused (parameter 2).

locut.description: Bass cutoff frequency (banner: 'defalut: no bass cutoff' - CDP's own typo). CDP-enforced 0 to 22050 ('-l100000' refused verbatim, Parameter[3]). Verified live at 300 Hz.

examples.description: Fog over the brilliance, body intact.
examples.expected_use: Everything above 2 kHz smears over half a second; the low spectrum stays articulate.
Upper spectrum blurred across the whole file; bass below 150 Hz removed.

known_issues: blurfact's bounds are input-dependent (2 frames to the analysed duration, quoted in the refusal) - long files allow long blurs.
No time-variable parameters (breakpoint refusals verbatim, parameters 1 and 2).
wav input refused ('ERROR: File <name> is not of correct type'); engine auto-PVOCs.
Deterministic (1.3 s-apart runs byte-identical in the data chunk).
